name: Gnomes Win!
summary: In Thousand Needles, a gnome race ticket pays off when the gnomes come out ahead. A prize box comes back to whoever held the winning stub.

sections.title: The Gnome Ticket
sections.body: The gnome race ticket is the stub that counts when the gnomes win. Hold on to it, and a gnome prize box is yours once the result is in. The goblin ticket has a result of its own, for the other side of the race.

faq.q: What is the Gnome Race Ticket?
faq.answer: It is the ticket for the gnome side of the race in Thousand Needles. It matters when the gnomes win.

faq.q: What do you get when the gnomes win?
faq.answer: A gnome prize box comes to whoever holds the gnome race ticket when the gnomes come out ahead.

faq.q: Who can take part in this wager?
faq.answer: It belongs to neither faction, so Alliance and Horde travelers are on the same footing.

faq.q: What happens if the goblins win instead?
faq.answer: Then the goblin ticket is the one that matters. Its result is called Goblins Win!, the counterpart to this one.
